title: OPEN HOUSE at 3009 Mission St Studio $2,200
body:

title: LOCATION! LOCATION! LOCATION! REMODELED! Top Floor 1 Bedroom Unit!
body:
This beautiful remodeled top floor one bedroom apartment is located on convenient Dolores Street. The building is directly across from Whole Foods Market and walking distance to Safeway, Dolores Park, Muni, BART, Mission District, The Castro, Delfina, Tartine Bakery, Mission Beach Cafe, Bi-Rite Market and Creamery, other great restaurants, bars, retail, and so much more!

This unit features:
- REMODELED!
- Ample windows allowing for lots of natural light.
- Hardwood floors throughout.
- Kitchen with lots of cabinets for storage.
- Separate dining area next to kitchen.
- 2 large walk-in closets.
- Tiled bathroom has shower over tub.
- Spacious floor plan.
- Owner managed property.

NO APPLICATION FEE!
12 month lease term
Rent - $3,300
Security deposit - $3,300
No smoking
Utilities - owner pays water, garbage, and heat.

To schedule a tour or for more information please respond to this ad.

title: Lovely Studio in Historic Italianate Victorian with Garden
body:
This is a small but charming and cozy studio in a beautiful historic 1880s Italianate Victorian. The location is excellent — close to the numerous restaurants, cafes, and nightlife of the Mission, Castro, Hayes Valley, and Lower Haight. Great access to public transportation and the 101 on/off ramps. Tech shuttle stops and Whole Foods are nearby. This unit sits at the border of Upper Market, Castro, and Mission neighborhoods.
The unit includes:

Multiple large windows with arched Victorian details
Cherry wood and tile flooring throughout
Rear door to lovely quiet (shared) garden with avocado tree
Small closet within unit and dedicated closet in hallway
Fireplace with gas insert
Renovated bathroom with glass-enclosed shower, large-format tile, and floating vanity
Antique chandelier lighting with original ceiling medallion
Soaring 10'4" ceilings with original period molding
Kitchen with cobalt blue tile backsplash, gas range, and stainless refrigerator
Approximately 200 square feet
Wired for Comcast high speed internet
Unfurnished

Building includes:

Stunning Victorian entry hall with original staircase and rose window
Video security system
Video intercom entry
Common-use garden area
Common-use laundry room

Lease:

Available July 1st, not beforehand. Lease to start July 1st.
Strict no-smoker unit/building
Strictly no-pet policy
Good credit and references required
$2,100/month rent
Security deposit $2,100
Tenant pays water/sewer and trash
12-month lease term

Please confirm attendance at open houses prior to coming.
Open House times: Thursday June 11th 5:00-6:00pm, Saturday June 13th 2:00-3:00pm
